newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Oct business inventories rose 0.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Oct business inventories rose 0.5 pct.

text.p: The Commerce Department said U.S. October business inventories rose 0.5 percent after a 0.1 percent increase in September. It said October business sales rose 0.2 percent after a revised 0.7 percent increase in September.
The following lists business inventories and sales by sector, in billions of dollars, seasonally adjusted:
The inventory-to-sales ratio is a measure of how long it would take to sell existing stocks at the current pace.
Wall Street economists had expected October business inventories to rise 0.2 percent.
The department said the 0.5 percent increase in October inventories was the largest monthly gain since January's 0.6 percent increase.
The department revised September sales from a previously reported 0.8 percent increase.
The Department said the monthly inventories and sales report would be released at 8.30 a.m. EST (1330 GMT) starting with the next report due on January 15.
